articleBody:
Picking out a new bathroom vanity can be exciting, but getting the right fit is crucial for a smooth installation and a functional space. You want something that looks great but also works seamlessly with your existing setup. Here’s a quick checklist to help you make sure your new vanity is a perfect match before you buy.

- [ ] Wall width and available depth — why it matters: These measurements are non-negotiable for ensuring your vanity fits the physical space without feeling cramped or obstructing movement. Don't forget to account for any trim or molding.
- [ ] Door and drawer clearances — why it matters: You need enough room for cabinet doors and drawers to open fully without hitting walls, toilets, or other fixtures. This is a common oversight that can lead to daily frustration.
- [ ] Existing drain and supply line locations — why it matters: Knowing where your pipes are now will tell you if you need to stick with a similar vanity layout or if professional plumbing modifications will be necessary.
- [ ] Countertop height preference — why it matters: While standard heights exist, personal comfort is key. Consider who will be using the vanity and what height works best for them.
- [ ] Wall-mount load requirements (if applicable) — why it matters: For wall-hung vanities, the wall structure must be able to support the weight of the unit, the countertop, and anything stored inside. This often means locating studs or reinforcing the wall.
- [ ] Moisture-resistant construction and sealed edges — why it matters: Bathrooms are wet environments! You need materials that can stand up to humidity and splashes to prevent warping, peeling, and mold over time.

How to use this checklist: Before you finalize your vanity purchase, go through each item on this list. Measure carefully, consider your current bathroom layout, and think about how the new vanity will integrate. If you’re unsure about things like wall support or plumbing alterations, that’s a good sign it’s time to chat with a professional. They can help you confirm your choices and ensure a successful installation. What to do next: Give Frasheski Construction a call at 510-318-2258 to discuss your vanity installation needs.
